hook: A dog, alone on a roof, in a sea of floodwater.
narration: After Hurricane Florence, a Guard helicopter crew spotted a dog alone on a rooftop, [short pause] with no one anywhere near it.
They lowered a swiftwater rescue swimmer to check.
No owner. So he put the dog in a special harness and rode the hoist back up with it.
The crew wasn't sure the dog would have made it otherwise.
outcome: The dog rode the hoist up into the helicopter and was flown to dry land.
title: Dog stranded alone on a flooded roof
description:
After Hurricane Florence in September 2018, a Connecticut National Guard helicopter crew supporting North Carolina spotted a dog stranded alone on a roof. A swiftwater rescue swimmer put the dog in a harness and rode the hoist up with it.

Footage: U.S. Army video, Connecticut National Guard, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/652963
